examples.english: My family will eat fish by the sea.
examples.transliteration: Eylety hatakol samak ala el bahr

examples.arabic: على العشا شاف سمك و رز و خضار
examples.english: At dinner, he saw fish, rice, and vegetables.
examples.transliteration: ʕala l-ʕasha shāf samak w rozz w khoḍaar.

examples.english: The food was rice and fish.
examples.transliteration: El akl kan rozz w samak.

examples.arabic: اميرة ردت وقالت ده سمك ورز مع خضار
examples.english: Amira replied and said: This is fish and rice with vegetables.
examples.transliteration: Amīra raddet w qālet: dah samak w rozz maʿ khoḍaar.
examples.storyTitle: A Nice Smell from the Neighbors' Apartment

examples.arabic: هناك عايزين ناكل سمك و نشرب شاي
examples.english: There we want to eat fish and drink tea.
examples.transliteration: Henak ayzeen nakol samak w neshrab shay.

examples.arabic: ونجيب سمك طازة وناكل جنب المينا
examples.english: And we'll get fresh fish and eat next to the harbor.
examples.transliteration: We nigeeb samak taze we nakol ganb el-meena.
